content:
kevin_sre: Pagerduty SEV2 alert — elevated tail latency and streaming stalls reported on /v1/generate starting ~07:12UTC. Multiple customers impacted. Paging on-call: @anya_ml, @mike_ops.

infra-bot: Alert details: p95 jumped from ~300ms to ~1.2s, p99 up to ~3.8s. Streaming stall rate increased (chunk gaps). Related node: gpu-node-17.

anya_ml: I'm seeing model-side queue growth for model-x-4bit; median queue length 8 -> 40 around 07:11-07:13UTC. Per-step time spikes in traces. Could be hardware degradation.

mike_ops: Running initial node checks now.

mike_ops: ```
ssh ops@gpu-node-17 'sudo dmesg | tail -n 80'
ssh ops@gpu-node-17 'nvidia-smi -q' | egrep "ECC|Temperature|Xid" -A 6
kubectl get pods -o wide -n serving | grep gpu-node-17
```

mike_ops: dmesg contains repeated Xid 31/63 errors and thermal throttling messages. nvidia-smi shows GPU temps ~90C and clocks dropping. Pod logs show inference loop stalls waiting on step N for multiple seconds intermittently.

kevin_sre: That matches tail latency. Proposed mitigation: 1) temp routing fallback to smaller/quantized model variant 2) cordon+drain gpu-node-17 3) evacuate pods to healthy nodes 4) replace GPU hardware.

sophie_eng: I'll update routing policies to shift some traffic off model-x. Which weight do we want? Start small 25-35%?

anya_ml: Send 30% to model-x-small (quantized) to reduce load but keep quality checks running. Also enable prefix-caching for hot routes if possible.

sophie_eng: Executing runtime routing change now.

sophie_eng: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/runtime-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"fallbacks":[{"model":"model-x-small","weight":30}]}}'
```

infra-bot: Routing policy updated. New split: 70% model-x, 30% model-x-small. Router confirms traffic shift.

kevin_sre: Increase per-route concurrency limit from 100 -> 140 to reduce head-of-line for other requests while we migrate.

mike_ops: Cordon + drain started: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods are being rescheduled to gpu-node-23 and gpu-node-24.

anya_ml: Monitoring synthetic evals and customer-facing metrics: within 5 minutes after split, p95 drops to ~600ms and streaming stalls reduced from ~12/min to ~2-4/min. Good signal.

mike_ops: Node shows persistent ECC counts and thermal events — filed vendor ticket (CHASSIS-4523) and flagged for GPU replacement.

kevin_sre: Customer impact summary for CS: several customers saw degraded streaming UX; 6 customer support tickets related to stalls, two enterprise customers reported visible slowdowns. CS notified and we've drafted a customer message.

cs_bot: Draft message sent to CS channel for review.

anya_ml: Action items for postmortem: collect full dmesg dump, nvidia-smi -q logs, pod-level latency traces, router decision logs, and Grafana screenshots at 07:10/07:15/07:25UTC. Also validate quality metrics for model-x-small traffic.

kevin_sre: Ops tasks: INFRA-653 created to add temperature-based eviction to autoscaler and lower ECC-error alert thresholds. Also order replacement GPUs and schedule hardware swap for gpu-node-17.

mike_ops: Temporary org-level routing overrides applied for high-SLA org-458 and org-993 to prefer non-affected region until node fully replaced.

sophie_eng: Noted — will keep monitoring for 60 minutes, then handoff to night oncall @kevin_sre for follow-up unless escalation needed.

infra-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Notes: routing fallback in place, gpu-node-17 cordoned/drained, hardware fault identified. Linked ticket INC-2025-2743 created with logs.

kevin_sre: Handoff plan: I'll remain until pods settled and latency stable for 30m. After that, handoff to night oncall @sophie_eng. Please attach all artifacts to INC-2025-2743.

anya_ml: I'll run regression eval overnight to detect any quality regressions from model-x-small traffic. If we see drift, we'll revert split.

sophie_eng: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open for 60m for monitoring. If regression or stalls reappear, page full oncall. :white_check_mark:

-- end of thread --
